headline: Up to 130% hike: 9th pay scale proposal heads to cabinet in two weeks
summary: Government employees in grades 11-20 could see an average basic salary increase of 130%, while grades 1-10 may receive up to 100%.
details: The finance division has been directed to present the proposed recommendations for the ninth pay scale before the cabinet within the next two weeks. The directive was issued during a meeting chaired by Cabinet Secretary Nasimul Ghani.
caption:
Basic salaries for government employees could surge by up to 130%.

headline: Over 34,000 treated as Khamenei's funeral rites begin in Iran
summary: Authorities deployed extra ambulances and medical units to avoid a repeat of the 1989 tragedy where thousands were injured in crowds.
details: More than 34,000 people received medical treatment while attending the funeral rites of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
// No deaths have been reported so far, according to the country's emergency services department.
caption:
34,000+ people treated during Khamenei's funeral rites. No deaths reported, but the scale of medical intervention was massive.

More than 34,000 people received medical treatment while attending the funeral rites of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

// No deaths have been reported so far, according to the country's emergency services department.
